scripts.cf:build: TJ_API_BASE_URL=${TJ_API_BUILD_BASE_URL:-https://tj-api-edge-preview.andreaem.workers.dev} CLOUDFLARE_PREVIEW=1 opennextjs-cloudflare build --config wrangler.preview.jsonc && CLOUDFLARE_PREVIEW=1 node scripts/configure-cloudflare-headers.mjs
scripts.cf:build:production: TJ_API_BASE_URL=${TJ_API_BUILD_BASE_URL:-https://backend.techjournal.it} CLOUDFLARE_PREVIEW=0 opennextjs-cloudflare build --config wrangler.production.jsonc && CLOUDFLARE_PREVIEW=0 node scripts/configure-cloudflare-headers.mjs
scripts.cf:deploy:preview: npm run cf:check:preview && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --config wrangler.preview.jsonc
scripts.cf:dry-run:production: npm run cf:check:production && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.production.jsonc
